## Goal
Define the lightweight Open Brain receipt schema and the stricter hooks future Closed Brain will need for privileged provenance.

## Scope
- Model source files read, files written/touched, generated artifacts, base documents/templates, command/tool evidence, external channels, validation checks, timestamps, agent identity, namespace, and session key.
- Define which fields are required for normal Open Brain and which are Closed Brain strict-mode requirements.
- Keep receipts citation-safe and secret-safe.
- Map receipts to existing session event types artifact and receipt where possible.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Schema is documented and issue-sized implementation follow-ups are clear.
- Receipt examples cover report generation, source file reads, generated artifacts, and base PDF/template use.
- Closed Brain strict-mode deltas are explicitly marked.

## Timeline
Target date: 2026-06-26. This blocks receipt helper implementation on 2026-06-27.
